blocks.text: 點一枝你走的時留落的菸
blocks.spelling: tiám tsi̍t ki lí tsáu ê sî lâu lo̍h ê hun

blocks.text: 了結著你我的情份
blocks.spelling: liáu-kiat tio̍h lí-guá tsîng-hūn

blocks.text: 願從此我袂擱想你會心酸
blocks.spelling: guān tsiông-tshú guá buē koh siūnn lí ē sim-sng

blocks.text: 只會記 你講你愛阮
blocks.spelling: tsí ē-kì lí kóng lí ài gún

blocks.text: 我盡量來保持一個分寸
blocks.spelling: guá tsīn-liōng lâi pó-tshî tsi̍t ê hun-tshùn

blocks.text: 不通怪我攏抓袂準
blocks.spelling: m̄-thang kuài guá lóng lia̍h buē tsún

blocks.text: 因為愛情帶來快樂的時陣
blocks.spelling: in-uī ài-tsîng tuà-lâi khuài-lo̍k ê sî-tsūn

blocks.text: 伊同時也帶來憂悶
blocks.spelling: i tông-sî iā tuà-lâi iu-būn

blocks.text: 這無關著愛情無關美麗青春
blocks.spelling: tse bô-kuan tio̍h ài-tsîng m̄-kuan bí-lē tshing-tshun

blocks.text: 你就不免為我打算
blocks.spelling: lí tio̍h m̄-bián uî guá phah-sǹg

blocks.text: 那感情惦你我心中變成疑問
blocks.spelling: ná kám-tsîng tiām lí-guá sim-tiong piàn-sîng gî-būn

blocks.text: 這一切 就攏無準算
blocks.spelling: tse it-tshè tio̍h lóng bô tsún-sǹg
